source.itkc.note: Searches ITKC's classical originals (Classical Texts, the Korean Literary Collections, and the Korean Classics Collection) online. ITKC returns an excerpt of about 150 characters around the match, cut at both ends, so results show only what the excerpt contains; the title opens the record on ITKC. The first 100 records per collection are checked. Nothing is stored.

source.ndl.note: Searches OCR text from NDL's classical books (NDL Lab). NDL requires a phrase of at least two characters. CPE sends the longer element or longest term and checks the remaining conditions in the supplied excerpts. OCR may contain recognition errors; excerpts have no punctuation and may be cut at both ends. Check the page image through the title link before citing. Only the first 50 books are checked. Nothing is stored.

source.cbeta.note: Searches the CBETA Buddhist canon online (CBData API). CPE sends the longer element or longest term. CBETA supplies about 40 characters on each side of each hit; CPE checks the remaining conditions in those excerpts. Interlinear notes are excluded. Only the first 50 juan are checked; titles open the corresponding juan in CBETA Online. Texts: CBETA Chinese Electronic Tripitaka Collection, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial use, attribution, share alike). Nothing is stored.

source.docusky.note: Searches the 佛寺志靈應故事 public database on DocuSky: selected stories from 普陀洛迦新志 and 清涼山志, not the complete books. One element or word is sent; the first page (up to 50 records; 5 for 大明一統志) is checked first, and reviewed profiles can manually request up to 5 pages one click per page. Only isolated source paragraphs are searched; research tags and unsupported body text are excluded. Titles open the project page. Compiler: 曹德啓; data: 中華佛學研究所; platform: 臺灣大學數位人文研究中心. Personal, non-commercial research use under the provider's terms. Nothing is stored. The catalog also lists duplicate entries, metadata databases, and modern-language or translated databases. Only the reviewed database's body text has been inspected; every other entry is marked unreviewed.

source.nrich.note: Loads up to 600 public wooden-tablet records and searches their supplied transcriptions, including Idu. This loaded set is not the full database and is reused in later searches. Results are candidate references whose characters match your input; transcription notation is kept as supplied. Confirm pattern suitability from the original material; it is not judged automatically. The first load may take a little while. Personal non-commercial research only. Loaded material is not automatically saved to files.

search.pattern.guide:
Search your text folders by entering fixed characters, the number of characters between them, and where to look.

Fill in the boxes from left to right: enter the first word (e.g. 以), the minimum and maximum number of characters after it (e.g. 1 to 20, shown in column A), the second word (e.g. 爲), and optionally a trailing character count (shown in column B). Leave a count box blank or set it to 0 when the words appear right next to each other, or write alternatives with | (e.g. 以|用).

Use "+ Add word" if your pattern has three or more fixed words, "Excluded characters" to list characters that must not appear in a blank (separated by commas), and "Search within" to choose within period (.), within comma (,), or a custom character span.

You can also open a pattern file (.toml, UTF-8) to run several patterns at once. Pattern DSL searches your text folders only.
